title: Structured brainstorming and convergence
description: Generates diverse ideas independently, synthesizes them, and ranks options through a transparent vote.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: structured-brainstorming-convergence
  title: Structured brainstorming and convergence
  description: Generates diverse ideas independently, synthesizes them, and ranks options through a transparent vote.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Move from broad idea generation to a prioritized, actionable set of concepts.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 6
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - facilitator-signoff
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Challenge statement and constraints
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - challenge
          - criteria
          - constraints
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: ideate
      kind: agent
      name: Divergent ideation
      role: Creative contributor
      prompt: Generate distinct ideas without premature evaluation. Include rationale, assumptions, and implementation notes.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - write
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: synthesize
      kind: agent
      name: Cluster and synthesize ideas
      role: Innovation facilitator
      prompt: Cluster duplicate ideas, name themes, preserve novel outliers, and produce concise candidate concepts.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: vote
      name: Score and vote
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      role: Criteria voting facilitator
      prompt: Score the synthesized concepts against the declared weighted criteria, preserve individual votes and dissent,
        and return a transparent ranking.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        permissions:
          - read-only
    - id: plan
      kind: agent
      name: Define next experiments
      role: Product strategist
      prompt: For top concepts, define low-cost experiments, success metrics, owners, and decision dates.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - experiment-design
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: facilitator-signoff
      kind: approval
      name: Facilitator approves outcomes
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Idea inventory, ranked concepts, and experiment plan
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: ideate
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: ideate
      to: synthesize
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: synthesize
      to: vote
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: vote
      to: plan
      kind: data
    - id: e5
      from: plan
      to: facilitator-signoff
      kind: dependency
    - id: e6
      from: facilitator-signoff
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
